sentences.text: Honestly, sorry, this might not be the best example, but at my last job the leadership team basically didn't care about onboarding.
They kept saying the emails were the problem, which was kind of ridiculous if you looked at anything.
So I tend to just try to look at the data when I can, and I saw people weren't linking their bank.
We changed some things with the triggers and the screen and it got a lot better.
I think it was a pretty big improvement, if that makes sense.
